title: 第1841章 第九关前见真章 混沌守墓者现身第1840章 弹指连破五重关青莲真身现山巅
content_zh:
第1841章
第九关前见真章，混沌守墓者现身
林玄踏上通往山顶的最后一段山道。
这段山道，和前八关完全不同。
没有混沌雾气，没有陷阱，没有岔路。
只有一条笔直的白玉道路，直通山顶。
道路两旁，种满了金色的莲花，在星空中摇曳，散发着柔和的金色光芒。
林玄走在白玉道路上，脚步平稳。
但他心中清楚，这一段路，才是最危险的。
前八关，考验的是实力。
第九关，考验的恐怕不只是实力。
他走了大约一刻钟，前方出现了一座金色的宫殿。
那座宫殿，通体由金色玉石砌成，散发着柔和的金色光芒。
宫殿不大，只有三层楼高，但每一块玉石上，都刻满了密密麻麻的混沌符文。
那些符文在不断流转，仿佛活物一般。
宫殿大门敞开着，上方悬挂着一块匾额，上面写着四个大字——混沌青莲。
林玄站在大门外，看着那块匾额，沉默了片刻。
他迈步，踏入宫殿。
殿内空荡荡的，什么都没有，只有一片金色的光芒，从宫殿顶部洒落，照亮了整个大殿。
大殿中央，站着一个人。

那是一个老者。
穿着一件灰色的长袍，头发花白，面容苍老。
他闭着眼睛，身上没有任何气息波动，看起来，就像一个普通的凡人。
但林玄看到他的第一眼，瞳孔就猛然一缩。
他能感觉到，这个老者，不简单。
这个老者，比混沌之祖，还要强大。
那种强大不是修为上的强大，而是另外一种强大——一种，超越了修为的强大。
老者闭着眼睛，缓缓开口：“你，来了。”
他的声音，很轻，很淡，仿佛从很远的地方传来。
林玄看着他，目光平静：“朕，来了。”
老者缓缓睁开眼睛。
他的眼睛，是金色的。
那种金色，不是普通金色，而是混沌青莲的那种金色。
璀璨，深邃，仿佛蕴含了整个宇宙。
老者看着林玄，缓缓开口：“本座，等你很久了。”
林玄看着他，目光平静：“你是谁？”
老者看着他，缓缓开口：“本座，是混沌青莲的守墓者。”
林玄闻言，目光微微一凝：“守墓者？”
content_en:
Chapter 1841
See the real chapter before the ninth level, the Chaos Tomb Keeper appears
Lin Xuan stepped onto the last section of the mountain road leading to the top of the mountain.
This section of the mountain road is completely different from the first eight passes.
There is no fog of chaos, no traps, and no forks in the road.
There is only a straight white jade road leading directly to the top of the mountain.
Both sides of the road were planted with golden lotus flowers, swaying in the starry sky, emitting soft golden light.
Lin Xuan walked on the white jade road with steady steps.
But he knew in his heart that this section of the road was the most dangerous.
The first eight levels are a test of strength.
The ninth level may test more than just strength.
He walked for about a quarter of an hour, and a golden palace appeared in front of him.
The palace was entirely made of golden jade, exuding a soft golden light.
The palace is not big, only three stories high, but every piece of jade is engraved with dense chaos runes.
Those runes were constantly flowing, as if they were living creatures.
The palace door is open, and a plaque hangs above it with four big characters written on it - Chaos Qinglian.
Lin Xuan stood outside the gate, looked at the plaque, and was silent for a moment.
He stepped forward and entered the palace.
The palace was empty, there was nothing, only a golden light fell from the top of the palace, illuminating the entire hall.
In the middle of the hall, there was a person standing.
That's an old man.
Wearing a gray robe, with gray hair and an old face.
He had his eyes closed, and there was no breath fluctuation on his body. He looked like an ordinary mortal.
But when Lin Xuan saw him for the first time, his pupils suddenly shrank.
He could feel that this old man was not simple.
This old man is even more powerful than the Ancestor of Chaos.
That kind of power is not the power of cultivation, but another kind of power - one that surpasses the power of cultivation.
The old man closed his eyes and spoke slowly: "You are here."
His voice was very soft and faint, as if coming from a very far away place.
Lin Xuan looked at him with calm eyes: "I'm here."
The old man slowly opened his eyes.
His eyes are golden.
That kind of golden color is not ordinary golden color, but the golden color of Chaos Qinglian.
Bright and deep, it seems to contain the entire universe.
The old man looked at Lin Xuan and said slowly: "I, I have been waiting for you for a long time."
Lin Xuan looked at him with calm eyes: "Who are you?"
The old man looked at him and spoke slowly: "I am the tombkeeper of Chaos Qinglian."
When Lin Xuan heard this, his eyes narrowed slightly: "Tombkeeper?"
